thread:
ajay: FYI rolled runtime v2.14 -> canary 15% ~08:10 UTC. Seeing p95/p99 spike on text-gen workloads immediately. p99 from ~420ms -> ~1.8s

maria: noticed the alert too, dashboards in Datadog show the bump coincident with the canary window. p95 also up ~2x. :eyes:

sam: which change in v2.14 could cause this? we touched kernel selection heuristics and kv-cache eviction.

claire: can anyone link the deploy? deploy-bot: deployment metadata below.

deploy-bot: deployed runtime:v2.14 to cluster-prod-canary at 1998887768 by ajay. canary=15% routes -> runtime:v2.14

ajay: quick repro from support: curl to /v1/generate with short prompt returns 4x higher tail latencies. sample curl:```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer ****' -d '{"model":"rwd-small","prompt":"hi","max_tokens":64}'
```

natalie: grabbing flamegraphs from the canary pods now. which pod set? k8s label svc=runtime-canary

kyle: also adding a traffic split rollback plan: we can set canary to 0% and autoscale to previous kernel selector via config override.

maria: flamegraphs show a spike in time spent in matmul kernel selection and an increased number of kernel fallback paths triggered. linking trace: https://dd.redwood.ai/trace/trace-7a9c (short-lived, p99 spans high latency on kernel_probe())

sam: aha — kernel probe fallback means we might be hitting a slower CUDA code path for certain sequence lengths. v2.14 changed kernel heuristics for seq length < 128. Might misclassify and force small-batch path.

claire: what about kv-cache eviction change? that could increase per-request recompute for long chats. but support repro prompt is short.

ajay: agree likely kernel selection. mitigations: 1) roll canary back 2) pin canary to older kernel heuristics via feature-flag 3) temporary route affected customers to compatible runtime variant (runtimes v2.13).

ops-bot: action added: incident-1998887776 created, severity: P2, notify: eng-runtime, eng-sre.

natalie: uploaded flamegraphs and perf counters to /s3/ci-artifacts/1998887776/ — main diff shows more attempted kernel_compose calls and increased CUDA context switches.

kyle: running bisect: I'll build runtime with kernel_heuristic toggle off and spin a test canary (local perf) to confirm. if that repros locally we'll patch quickly.

maria: meanwhile, ajay can you reduce canary to 0%? we want to stop customer impact.

ajay: doing canary->0% now. command:
```bash
# rctl is our rollout control tool
rctl set-canary --service runtime --percent 0 --reason "p99 spike v2.14"
```

deploy-bot: canary percent updated: runtime canary=0% (triggered by ajay) at 1998887830

support-bot: received 3 escalations in the last 30m about slow responses on hosted API endpoints. shared workaround: set model_hint: rwd-small-v2.13 in customer config to route to previous runtime.

sam: after canary->0% metrics should stabilize within 1-2 min once in-flight requests drain. watch p95/p99 window.

claire: observed p99 back down to normal baseline at 1998887885 on prod overview. p95 trending down too. thanks. :tada:

ajay: good. next steps: kyle to bisect kernel heuristics; if confirmed we revert that heuristic in v2.14 and cut v2.14.1. natalie to collect perf artifacts; sam to draft postmortem + customer comms.

kyle: initial local bisect shows toggling `prefer_small_seq_matmul=true` to false removes the regression in our microbench. patch ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4321

maria: QA: can we run a canary with the patch at 5% and synthetic traffic to validate no regression in throughput?

ajay: yes, schedule 5% canary with synthetic qps and watch p99 for 30m. I'll coordinate.

sam: created PM-1999 for postmortem. include repro steps, graphs, link to PR, rollback timeline, and customer impact.

claire: customer success notified for impacted accounts, offering extended credits if needed.

ajay: thanks everyone. keeping this thread for final notes. once we cut v2.14.1 we'll schedule a slow rollout with a metric gate on p99 and kernel fallback count.

maria: note for runbook: add a metric for kernel_fallback_count and an alert threshold. saved.

kyle: merging PR now. will trigger a 5% canary tomorrow at 09:00 UTC with synthetic load test.

ajay: closing canary incident after remediation steps done. last check-in at 1998887923 - all good.
